[In a second-price sealed-bid auction, bidding your true private value is a dominant strategy: you win whenever the second-highest bid is below your value and pay that price, so shading can't increase expected profit. Values are independent each round and ties are random, so bid truthfully to maximize long-run expected surplus. My private value is $28, so I will bid that amount using the allowed $0.1 increments.]
